<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_InventoryRestock"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inventory-restock">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PurchaseOrder" name="Purchase order"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_InventoryRestock" name="Inventory restocking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Monitoring" name="Start inventory monitoring"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMethodSplit" name="Choose reorder signal method"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AutomatedAlert" name="Signal need with automated alert"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Signal need with manual check"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMethodMerge" name="Continue after reorder signal"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with suppliers" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" name="Update expected delivery dates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveStock" name="Receive stock"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock quality"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in the system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StorageSplit" name="Choose stock location"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOnShelves" name="Place stock on shelves"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceInStorage" name="Place stock in storage"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StorageMerge" name="Continue after put-away"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RestockComplete" name="Restock complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Monitoring" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMethodSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" name="Automated alert" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMethodSplit" targetRef="Task_AutomatedAlert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" name="Manual check" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMethodSplit" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMethodMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMethodMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMethodMerge" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStock" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Gateway_StorageSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Shelves" sourceRef="Gateway_StorageSplit" targetRef="Task_PlaceOnShelves"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Storage" sourceRef="Gateway_StorageSplit" targetRef="Task_PlaceInStorage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnShelves" targetRef="Gateway_StorageMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInStorage" targetRef="Gateway_StorageMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_StorageMerge" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_RestockComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_InventoryRestock">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_InventoryProcess" name="Warehouse or store" processRef="Process_InventoryRestock"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Suppliers" name="Suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PurchaseOrder" name="Purchase order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Participant_Suppliers" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
